high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Jane Austen Wrecked My Life." The poster has a clean, minimalist design with a white background and decorative borders at the top and bottom, giving it an elegant feel. Title: "Jane Austen Wrecked My Life" is prominently displayed in large, bold letters. "Wrecked" is in red, while the rest of the title is in black. Tagline: At the top, there's a quote that reads: "IT DOESN'T TAKE MUCH PERSUASION TO ENJOY! A charming romantic comedy
